page: Microsoft Azure D64ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running under Microsoft Hyper-V. The system provides 64 dedicated x86_64 virtual CPUs across 32 physical cores with multithreading enabled at a 3.7 GHz clock speed. System memory totals 256 GB, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance includes 3,780 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage. It operates without dedicated GPU hardware accelerators.

Benchmark data reflects strong computing and I/O capabilities across parallelized tasks. The instance achieved a top-tier score of 22,151 in Geekbench multi-core testing and demonstrated high image processing capability (17,666 points). In memory and transactional workloads, Redis SET operations reached 88.8 million operations per second, supported by 29,534.58 points in PassMark database operations and 51.24 GB/sec static web serving throughput. CPU extensions including AVX-512, VNNI, and BF16 also enabled rapid token processing on small CPU-based language models, achieving 4,455.04 tokens/sec on 135M parameter models.

The bundled 3.78 TB NVMe SSD storage delivers high qualitative cost efficiency for input/output-intensive operations by avoiding reliance on remote disk volumes for high-speed scratch space. A primary tradeoff involves large-block uncached memory read bandwidth, which scores in the average tier at 153.37 GB/sec, contrasting with strong cached read speeds of 4,863.97 GB/sec. Additionally, large 70B parameter LLM processing throughput remains limited without dedicated GPU coprocessors.

Microsoft Azure D64ads_v6 fits heavy relational databases, transactional memory caches, enterprise web application fleets, large-scale Clang compilation jobs, and multi-threaded data transformation pipelines requiring balanced compute density and rapid local disk access.
description: Microsoft Azure D64ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine powered by a 3.7 GHz AMD EPYC 9V74 processor offering 64 dedicated vCPUs and 256 GB of system RAM. Built on Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance features an integrated 3,780 GB local NVMe SSD, delivering substantial I/O throughput for fast-access local storage workflows without integrated GPUs. Benchmark evaluations show top-tier multi-core execution with a Geekbench score of 22,151, coupled with high transactional throughput demonstrated by 88.8 million Redis SET operations per second and 51.24 GB/sec web serving capacity. With AVX-512 and BF16 instructions, it efficiently executes dense computing tasks, parallel data pipelines, and light CPU inference. The balanced 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio and generous direct-attached NVMe storage make the D64ads_v6 well-suited for high-concurrency databases, distributed cache layers, continuous integration build clusters, and transactional web serving environments.
